goal_statement: Real-time visibility into outsourced gold orders across the full lifecycle — from receipt through vendor production, QC, payment and dispatch — with automated vendor coordination, correctly-routed reminders, and a single source of truth replacing manual Excel scripts.
frequency: Regular order cycles run every Monday & Thursday
success_metric: Zero manual Excel updates for gold order tracking; every outsourced gold order is visible in real time; payment reminders routed correctly with zero store-manager embarrassment incidents; vendor adoption across the ~25 external vendors.
infrastructure_overview: On-prem Kisna Force ERP + server-based Excel files. IT team exists (CTO: Nitin Naik, CDO: Ruvin Dholakia, Head: Sreerama Reddy).
approvals_needed: IT sign-off on Kisna Force API access (Ruvin/Nitin); Marketing team refinement of WhatsApp bot messaging; Leadership scope confirmation (Heet framed as one part of broader operations).
volume_per_cycle: ~25–35 pieces per store per cycle; custom orders capped at 3 pieces at a time
data_sensitivity: Financial data (order values, payment status), vendor commercial terms, store performance data. Payment routing rule is commercially sensitive — wrong routing damages store/customer relationship.
must_haves: Real-time vendor status tracking; automated criteria/credit-health check; correct notification routing (dispatch → store manager, payment → NOT store manager); WhatsApp API integration via Kisna number; 7-day payment window automation; role-based access (admin/order/QC/payment); Kisna Force integration; logistics tracking auto-link on payment confirmation
desired_output: Dashboard + Notification flow + Auto-action (order management + vendor portal + WhatsApp bot)
people_involved: Sales & Support team, ~25 external vendors, QC team, Payment team, Merchandising, Store managers, Franchise partners/AOMs
time_per_cycle: 48 hours to 15 days (production lead time); order lifecycle end-to-end varies by vendor and category
integration_boundaries: Must integrate with Kisna Force (ERP); WhatsApp API through Kisna's official number; logistics provider for tracking links. IT viability review pending with Kisna IT / Ruvin Dholakia for API linking.
trigger: Order received in Kisna Force from a store (COCO or franchise) — regular via run script, or custom/customer-specific which bypasses the script
nice_to_haves: Franchise suggested-ordering based on purchase history; liquidation-first ordering nudge; management analytics dashboard; merchandising's own dashboard view
error_rate: Variability of ~15–18% justifies the 5→7 day operational variance buffer; primary error surface is manual Excel updates and missed payment follow-ups
seasonality: Franchise stores show demand spikes during festive/wedding seasons
desired_look: Kisna One | Jewelry Operations & Vendor Portal — live at https://kisna-ss.claraai.tech/ — includes vendor assignment dashboard with order ID + store origin + real-time status, QC review checklist, automated 7-day payment reminder, WhatsApp bot via Kisna number, logistics tracking integration, management analytics (total gold orders, avg order value, customer segmentation, vendor-specific insights)
